about: Which ideas the site teaches and where. Each concept lists the lessons that teach it at each level (core, with a note on what that level adds), lessons that lean on it (uses), the films that show it and neighbouring ideas (near). Written offline by AI models from the lessons themselves (scripts/topic-graph), merged into one id per idea, read again by a second model that did not write it, and checked in CI by scripts/check-topic-graph.mjs. A lesson record is tied to the lesson's teaching text by hash; refresh with scripts/topic-graph/assign.mjs after a rewrite. Titles, courses and levels are not stored here: the site joins them at build time.
